# x360ce's controller database: for each controller, the complete setting most people use with it.
# Rows as SDL's gamecontrollerdb.txt writes them: GUID,name,users:{people},{x360ce.ini key}:{value},...
# Only settings not at their default; a controller whose setting sets nothing is left to SDL's database.
# Force feedback on at strength 0 is written at 100; a missing motor period with force feedback on is
# written at x360ce 4's default, 160 ms left and 64 ms right.
# Do not edit by hand: scripts\Update-X360ceDatabase.ps1 writes it from x360ce's server.
# Made: 2026-11-14 from x360ce's public settings service
# Rows: 787
# Partial copy: made from x360ce's public settings service for SDL's controllers, the most popular list, the controllers connected and known wheels, until the server serves the whole file.
